about.text: The storey and building summary rows nrc-enrich-run writes (README: How the enrichment rows are derived). containers places each element on one storey, its StoreyOfElement row with the smallest Depth, and in the building; inContainers joins the values to those placements (containers on the left so the layout keeps the values wire clear of the containers card); summaries aggregates each metric by its Rollup and rounds to its Decimals; provenance puts every field of nrc-run.csv on the project. 47 rows. zoneAnswer is a second output: the zone summary rows (zoneName instead of entityId, 28 values on the four zones of nrc-zones.csv), computed from the space values of nrc_analytics_spaces.csv by each metric's Rollup, the ratio rule dividing zone energy by zone floor area. nrc-enrich-run writes them on the IfcZone groups it creates.

containers.sql:
SELECT e.GlobalId, 'storey' AS Level, s.StepId AS entityId
FROM t1 so
JOIN t2 e ON e.EntityIndex = so.EntityIndex
JOIN t2 s ON s.EntityIndex = so.StoreyIndex
WHERE e.GlobalId IS NOT NULL
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY so.EntityIndex ORDER BY so.Depth, so.StoreyIndex) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT e.GlobalId, 'building', b.StepId
FROM t2 e JOIN t2 b ON b.Category = 'IFCBUILDING'
WHERE e.GlobalId IS NOT NULL

summaries.sql:
SELECT p.entityId, m.PropertySet AS psetName, m.PropertyName AS paramName, m.ValueType AS valueType,
       CASE m.Rollup
           WHEN 'sum' THEN CAST(round(sum(p.Value), CAST(m.Decimals AS INTEGER)) AS VARCHAR)
           WHEN 'mean' THEN CAST(round(avg(p.Value), CAST(m.Decimals AS INTEGER)) AS VARCHAR)
           WHEN 'count' THEN CAST(count(DISTINCT p.GlobalId) AS VARCHAR)
       END AS paramValue
FROM t1 p
JOIN t2 m ON m.Level = p.Level AND m.Rollup <> 'none' AND (m.Rollup = 'count' OR m.MetricId = p.MetricId)
GROUP BY p.entityId, m.PropertySet, m.PropertyName, m.ValueType, m.Rollup, m.Decimals
UNION
SELECT p.entityId, m.PropertySet, r.Field, r.ValueType, r.Value
FROM t1 p
JOIN t2 m ON m.Level = p.Level AND m.Rollup <> 'none'
JOIN t3 r ON r.Field IN ('AnalysisRunId', 'ScenarioName')
ORDER BY entityId, psetName, paramName

provenance.sql:
SELECT e.StepId AS entityId, 'NRC_AnalyticsProvenance' AS psetName, r.Field AS paramName,
       r.ValueType AS valueType, r.Value AS paramValue
FROM t1 e CROSS JOIN t2 r
WHERE e.Category = 'IFCPROJECT'
ORDER BY paramName

answer.sql: SELECT * FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM t2 ORDER BY entityId, psetName, paramName

zoneInputs.sql:
SELECT z.ZoneName AS zoneName, 'zone' AS Level, v.GlobalId, v.MetricId, v.Value
FROM t1 v JOIN t2 z ON z.SpaceGlobalId = v.GlobalId

zoneAnswer.sql:
SELECT p.zoneName, m.PropertySet AS psetName, m.PropertyName AS paramName, m.ValueType AS valueType,
       CASE WHEN m.Rollup = 'sum' THEN CAST(round(sum(p.Value), CAST(m.Decimals AS INTEGER)) AS VARCHAR)
            WHEN m.Rollup = 'mean' THEN CAST(round(avg(p.Value), CAST(m.Decimals AS INTEGER)) AS VARCHAR)
            WHEN m.Rollup = 'count' THEN CAST(count(DISTINCT p.GlobalId) AS VARCHAR)
            WHEN m.Rollup LIKE 'ratio:%' THEN CAST(round(
                sum(CASE WHEN p.MetricId = split_part(split_part(m.Rollup, ':', 2), '/', 1) THEN p.Value END)
                / sum(CASE WHEN p.MetricId = split_part(split_part(m.Rollup, ':', 2), '/', 2) THEN p.Value END),
                CAST(m.Decimals AS INTEGER)) AS VARCHAR)
       END AS paramValue
FROM t1 p
JOIN t2 m ON m.Level = p.Level AND m.Rollup <> 'none'
         AND (m.Rollup = 'count' OR m.Rollup LIKE 'ratio:%' OR m.MetricId = p.MetricId)
GROUP BY p.zoneName, m.PropertySet, m.PropertyName, m.ValueType, m.Rollup, m.Decimals
UNION
SELECT p.zoneName, m.PropertySet, r.Field, r.ValueType, r.Value
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT zoneName, Level FROM t1) p
JOIN t2 m ON m.Level = p.Level AND m.Rollup <> 'none'
JOIN t3 r ON r.Field IN ('AnalysisRunId', 'ScenarioName')
ORDER BY zoneName, psetName, paramName
